rv.q: "Pericles" is as moving and enveloping a Shakespearean production as I've seen all these years in CST's Courtyard Theatre, a space ideally designed and utilized here for what Harvey and these actors want to achieve.
I left moved but feeling mixed about this show.

With the stellar production of “Pericles,” all bodes well for the vibrant, imaginative collaboration between Chicago Shakes and the RSC that lays ahead.
To put it simply, Royal Shakespeare Company's Pericles is a production of imagination and wonder.
No more excuses: get thee to Navy Pier for one of the few opportunities you may ever have to see this show. You won't regret it.

PERICLES is an opportunity to see a lesser-known Shakespearean play performed by a company with its origin story rooted in Shakespeare's hometown.
The Bard’s message about power in this play is as strong as in more familiar works like Macbeth and Richard III .

This expertly crafted vision of antique mystical realism, a charmingly humorous morality play, with mythical goddesses interacting with mythical man, is the CST’s “100th international production bringing the world’s great artists to Chicago”.

cn.t: The Royal Shakespeare Company brings vibrant energy and exceptional ensemble work to Shakespeare's rarely-seen late romance, though the play's episodic structure and uneven authorship still show through.
